name: R. Mark Armstrong
background: R. Mark Armstrong of Albany County won the 2026 Republican primary for county clerk and lost the November 2026 general election. The Laramie Reporter reported the results as 4,246 votes (33%) to Kayla White's 8,596 (67%). No public-record occupation, education, or military service was found in the official Albany County election results or the other public records reviewed for this Profile.
